scope: Physical F4 partial: empirical H I hazard likelihood and sourced UVB moment adapter; no IVP
inputs: sources/lumina actual text files and metadata

Lumina_history_adapter.interpolation: piecewise-linear in z for all four; no floors
Lumina_history_adapter.domains: read exact endpoints from actual files; reject extrapolation
Lumina_history_adapter.HeIII_quantile_inversion: detect labeled ordering failure; median-only allowed; band UNRESOLVED_QUANTILE_LABELS; no sorting

interpolation.zero_rate: exact knot allowed; interval touching zero explicitly linear in rate, no floor
interpolation.observation_lograte: piecewise linear in z with covariance w^T C w

Wolfram_actual_calls.code: Clear[s11,s12,s22,r1,r2,b]; w={{s11,s12},{s12,s22}}; r={r1,r2}; one={1,1}; bh=(one.w.r)/(one.w.one); {FullSimplify[D[(r-b one).w.(r-b one),b]/.b->bh],FullSimplify[(r-bh one).w.(r-bh one)-(r.w.r-(one.w.r)^2/(one.w.one))],FullSimplify[(g/s1)*s1],FullSimplify[(1-u)*(e1-i)+u*(e2-i)-((1-u)*e1+u*e2-i)]}
Clear[u,v,w,r,s,t]; pp={{u,v},{v,w}}; rr={r,s}; vv={1,t}; th=-(vv.pp.rr)/(vv.pp.vv); FullSimplify[D[(rr+x vv).pp.(rr+x vv),x]/.x->th]
